caption: The video captures a single flame burning steadily against a uniform black background, already burning at the opening and still burning at the close. Its rounded, bulbous base stays anchored in the lower-center of the scene, while a brightly lit tongue leans diagonally toward the upper-right. The interior core glows yellow-white and the outer edges fade to soft orange, giving the whole form a blurred, soft-edged look. Over time, the tongue flickers continuously, its tip stretching upward to brush the top edge at moments before pulling back into a shorter, rounded point. The tilt and curvature of the tongue shift subtly, widening and narrowing the glowing region without ever extinguishing the flame. No other object enters the scene, leaving the restless burn as the sole visible process.
relations: Anchored bulbous base -> sustains the diagonal tongue's continuous flickering against the black background.
Yellow-white interior core -> drives the outer edges to fade to soft orange as the tongue stretches and retracts.
Shifting tilt and curvature -> widen and narrow the glowing region while the flame persists without extinguishing.
